description: ::ab{title="&L&Ninja Trick (Ex)&FN&" icon=power ability="A rogue with this talent can choose a trick from the ‹ability/ninja trick<s› list. The rogue cannot choose a ninja trick with the same name as a rogue talent." special="The rogue can choose but cannot use talents that require ki points, unless she has a ki pool. A rogue can pick this talent more than once."}

peerless_maneuver.name: Peerless Maneuver
description: ::ab{title="&L&Peerless Maneuver (Ex)&FN&" icon=roll ability="A rogue with this talent can roll two dice while making an ‹skill/Acrobatics› check, and take the better result. She must choose to use this talent before making the Acrobatics check." useInc=rogue~5~+ useF="1~1~5~1~5"}

philologist.name: Philologist
description: ::ab{title="&L&Philologist&FN&" icon=roll-boost ability="A rogue with this talent can reroll any ‹skill/Linguistics› skill check made to decipher writing in an unfamiliar language, and never risks drawing a false conclusion from a failed Wisdom check after a failed Linguistics check." special="A rogue with this talent is allowed only one reroll per inscription, message, or text encountered."}

quick_scrounge.name: Quick Scrounge
description: ::ab{title="&L&Quick Scrounge&FN&" icon=boost ability="The rogue can search a creature, object, or area in half as much time as normal. If her ‹skill/Perception› check would normally require a full-round action or less, it becomes one step shorter along the following progression: @HLfull-round_action, @HLstandard_action, @HLmove_action, @HLswift_action, @HLimmediate_action." special="This talent has no effect on Perception checks that are attempted as free actions or Perception checks that don't require an action."}

rapid_perception.name: Rapid Perception
description: ::ab{title="&L&Rapid Perception (Su)&FN&" icon=boost ability="A rogue with this talent can attempt a ‹skill/Perception› check to intentionally search for a specific item or creature as a @HLswift_action instead of a move action. If she is intentionally searching for an invisible creature, the creature's bonus on its Stealth check from its invisibility is halved."}

riding_stunt.name: Riding Stunt
description: ::ab{title="&L&Riding Stunt (Ex)&FN&" icon=boost ability="A rogue with this talent takes only a -2 penalty on ‹skill/Ride› checks when riding a mount bareback instead of the normal -5 penalty.~~~When using the Ride skill to make a mount leap, a rogue with this talent can use her Ride modifier or her mount's jump modifier, whichever is higher, instead of using the lower of the two.~~~A rogue with this talent gains a +5 competence bonus when using the Ride skill to soften a fall from her mount or to perform a fast mount or dismount.~~~Finally, a rogue with this talent can attempt a DC 15 Ride check to recover from a position of cover as a @HLfree_action instead of as a move action. Failing this check results in the recovery requiring a move action as normal." prereq="Trained in ‹skill/Ride›"}

rope_master.name: Rope Master
description: ::ab{title="&L&Rope Master (Ex)&FN&" icon=boost ability="A rogue with this ability can move at her normal speed when using rope on a ‹skill/Climb› check, can take 10 when using ‹skill/Acrobatics› to move over narrow surfaces even when in danger or distracted, and gains a +4 bonus when determining the DC to escape bonds when she ties up a creature."}

strong_impression.name: Strong Impression
description: ::ab{title="&L&Strong Impression&FN&" icon=power ability="A rogue who selects this talent gains ‹feat/Intimidating Prowess› as a bonus feat."}

strong_stroke.name: Strong Stroke
description: ::ab{title="&L&Strong Stroke (Ex)&FN&" icon=roll-boost ability="A rogue with this talent rolls twice when making ‹skill/Swim› checks and takes the better result. If she already rolls twice while making a Swim check because of another ability or effect, she gains a +2 insight bonus on both of those rolls instead. If the rogue is under the effect of a spell or ability that forces her to roll two dice and take the worse result, she only needs to roll 1d20 while making Swim checks."}

survivalist.name: Survivalist
description: ::ab{title="&L&Survivalist&FN&" icon=skill info="A rogue with this talent adds ‹skill/Heal› and ‹skill/Survival› to her list of class skills."}

swift_tracker.name: Swift Tracker
description: ::ab{title="&L&Swift Tracker (Ex)&FN&" icon=boost ability="While following tracks, the rogue can move at her normal speed without penalty while using the ‹skill/Survival› skill. In addition, the penalty for moving at up to twice her normal speed while following tracks is reduced to -10."}

thrill_of_the_chase.name: Thrill of the Chase
description: ::ab{title="&L&Thrill of the Chase (Ex)&FN&" icon=roll-power flavor="The rogue revels in the thrill and adrenaline rush of a challenging chase." ability="When engaged in ‹rule/a »chase<s› or ‹rule/pursuit›, the rogue gains one d20 reroll which she can use at any time after the original roll is made but before the results of the roll are revealed; she must take the second result, even if it is lower.~~~She can use this reroll once per chase or once per day during a pursuit." order=a2 ability2="Additionally, she gains ‹feat/Run› as a bonus feat."}

wall_scramble.name: Wall Scramble
description: ::ab{title="&L&Wall Scramble (Ex)&FN&" icon=roll-boost ability="A rogue with this talent rolls twice when making ‹skill/Climb› checks and takes the better of the two rolls. If she already rolls twice while making a Climb check because of another ability or effect, she gains a +2 insight bonus on both of those rolls instead. If the rogue is under the effect of a spell or ability that forces her to roll two dice and take the worse result, she only needs to roll 1d20 while making Climb checks."}

confounding_blades.name: Confounding Blades
description: ::ab{title="&L&Confounding Blades (Ex)&FN&" icon=lower ability="When a rogue with this talent hits a creature with a melee weapon that deals sneak attack damage, her target cannot make attacks of opportunity for 1d4+1 rounds." prereq="‹talent/Slow reactions›"}

crippling_strike.name: Crippling Strike
description: ::ab{title="&L&Crippling Strike (Ex)&FN&" icon=lower ability="A rogue with this ability can sneak attack opponents with such precision that her blows weaken and hamper them. An opponent damaged by one of her sneak attacks also takes 2 points of ‹rule/Strength damage›."}

deadly_sneak.name: Deadly Sneak
description: ::ab{title="&L&Deadly Sneak (Ex)&FN&" icon=boost passive="Whenever a rogue with this talent uses the *powerful sneak* rogue talent, she treats all 1s and 2s on the sneak attack damage dice as 3s." prereq="‹talent/Powerful sneak›"}

deadly_sneak_unchained_rogue.name: Deadly Sneak (Unchained Rogue)
description: ::ab{title="&L&Deadly Sneak (Unchained Rogue) (Ex)&FN&" icon=roll ability="When a rogue with this talent uses the *powerful sneak* talent, she rerolls all sneak attack dice that resulted in 1s or 2s. She can reroll multiple dice, but she can't reroll any individual die more than once per attack." prereq="‹talent/Powerful sneak›"}

dispelling_attack.name: Dispelling Attack
description: ::ab{title="&L&Dispelling Attack (Su)&FN&" icon=lower ability="Opponents that are dealt sneak attack damage by a rogue with this ability are affected by a targeted ‹spell/dispel magic›, targeting the lowest-level spell effect active on the target. The caster level for this ability is equal to the rogue's level." prereq="‹talent/Major magic›"}

double_debilitation.name: Double Debilitation
description: ::ab{title="&L&Double Debilitation (Ex)&FN&" icon=lower ability="Whenever the rogue inflicts a penalty against a target using the *debilitating injury* class feature, she can select two penalties to inflict. The target can never be subject to more than two penalties in this way at one time. If any additional penalties are inflicted, any previous penalties immediately end. Any effect that heals damage to the target negates both of the penalties."}

entanglement_of_blades.name: Entanglement of Blades
description: ::ab{title="&L&Entanglement of Blades (Ex)&FN&" icon=lower ability="When a rogue with this talent hits a creature with a melee attack that deals sneak attack damage, the target cannot take a 5-foot step until the beginning of the rogue's next turn."}

hamstring_strike.name: Hamstring Strike
description: ::ab{title="&L&Hamstring Strike (Ex)&FN&" icon=lower ability="Anytime a rogue with this talent successfully hits an opponent with a sneak attack, she may forgo her sneak attack damage to try to hamstring her opponent. If the attack succeeds, the rogue deals weapon damage as normal, but instead of the rogue dealing sneak attack damage, the target is knocked ‹rule/prone› and is unable to take move actions during its next turn. A successful Fortitude save (DC = 10 + 1/2 the rogue's level + the rogue's Dexterity modifier) negates this effect."}

harrow_strike.name: Harrow Strike
description: ::ab{title="&L&Harrow Strike (Ex)&FN&" icon=lower ability="Once per day while making a sneak attack against a creature, you can draw a random card from a ‹eq-misc/harrow deck› you own. If your attack hits, instead of dealing sneak attack damage as normal, you deal a number of points of ability damage equal to your number of sneak attack dice. The ability score damaged is the score affiliated with the suit of the harrow card drawn." incrementPlain="You can use~10~5" incrementDesc=this incrementEnd=" times/day."}

improved_shadows_chill.name: Improved Shadow's Chill
description: ::ab{title="&L&Improved Shadow's Chill (Su)&FN&" icon=boost ability="When a rogue with this talent hits a creature with a melee weapon that deals sneak attack damage, the sneak attack damage is cold damage. Normal weapon damage is unaffected." prereq="Has cold ‹umr/resistance› from a racial trait, ‹talent/shadow's chill›"}

petrifying_strike.name: Petrifying Strike
description: ::ab{title="&L&Petrifying Strike (Su)&FN&" icon=lower ability="Whenever the rogue damages a creature with one of her sneak attacks, she also deals 2 points of ‹rule/Dexterity damage› to that creature as its body petrifies."}

resonating_rumbles.name: Resonating Rumbles
description: ::ab{title="&L&Resonating Rumbles (Su)&FN&" icon=lower ability="When a rogue with this talent makes a successful sneak attack against a creature with ‹umr/tremorsense›, the rogue can subtract 3 dice from her sneak attack damage to prevent the target from using tremorsense for a number of rounds equal to half her rogue level."}

aligned_disguise.name: Aligned Disguise
description: ::ab{title="&L&Aligned Disguise (Sp)&FN&" icon=def ability="When a rogue with this talent uses the ‹spell/disguise self› spell-like ability, she can also alter her alignment aura to deceive spells that discern alignment (such as ‹spell/detect evil›) for the duration of the disguise self effect. She can choose to detect as any specific alignment, or to detect as no alignment at all. This ability does not protect against spells or effects that cause harm based on alignment." prereq="Has *disguise self* as a spell-like ability"}

familiar.name: Familiar
description: ::ab{title="&L&Familiar (Ex)&FN&" icon=power ability="A rogue with this talent gains a ‹sidekick/familiar› as the ‹ability/familiar› option of the wizard's *arcane bond* class feature. This ability functions exactly like that part of the class feature, but the rogue's effective wizard level is her rogue level -4." prereq="‹talent/Minor magic›, ‹talent/major magic›"}

founders_blessing.name: Founders' Blessing
description: ::ab{title="&L&Founders' Blessing&FN&" icon=boost flavor="The rogue can call upon the mystical legacies of the Council." ability="Once per day, she can choose a skill in which she has no ranks. After she spends 10 minutes communing with these mystical spirits, they grant her a luck bonus equal to her rogue level with that skill, and she can attempt checks with that skill as if she were trained in its use. The effects of *founder's blessing* last for 8 hours."}

glib_facade.name: Glib Facade
description: ::ab{title="&L&Glib Facade (Sp)&FN&" icon=magic ability="Once per day, a rogue with this advanced talent can use ‹spell/glibness› as a spell-like ability, using her rogue level as the spell's caster level." prereq="‹talent/Innocent facade›"}

hidden_mind.name: Hidden Mind
description: ::ab{title="&L&Hidden Mind (Ex)&FN&" icon=def ability="A rogue with this talent uses various devious techniques, including mental exercises and dusting her clothing with a small amount of lead, to protect herself from divinations, with the same benefits as if she cast ‹spell/nondetection› on herself with a caster level equal to her rogue level."}

slippery_mind.name: Slippery Mind
description: ::ab{title="&L&Slippery Mind (Ex)&FN&" icon=def flavor="This ability represents the rogue's ability to wriggle free from magical effects that would otherwise control or compel her." passive="If a rogue with *slippery mind* is affected by an enchantment spell or effect and fails her saving throw, she can attempt it again 1 round later at the same DC. She gets only this one extra chance to succeed on her saving throw."}

against_the_wall.name: Against the Wall
description: ::ab{title="&L&Against the Wall (Ex)&FN&" icon=boost ability="A rogue with this talent is considered to be ‹rule/flanking› any opponent adjacent to a stone wall (whether the stone is worked or unworked)."}

another_day.name: Another Day
description: ::ab{title="&L&Another Day (Ex)&FN&" icon=def-down immediate="Once per day, when the rogue would be reduced to 0 or fewer hit points by a melee attack, she can take a 5-foot step. If the movement takes her out of the reach of the attack, she takes no damage from the attack. The rogue is ‹misc/staggered› for 1 round on her next turn."}

blinding_strike.name: Blinding Strike
description: ::ab{title="&L&Blinding Strike&FN&" icon=power ability="A rogue who selects this talent gains ‹feat/Blinding Critical› as a bonus feat, even if she doesn't meet the prerequisites." prereq="15th-level rogue, ‹talent/obscuring blow›"}

dance_of_disorienting_shadows.name: Dance of Disorienting Shadows
description: ::ab{title="&L&Dance of Disorienting Shadows (Ex)&FN&" icon=melee ability="A rogue with this talent can attempt a ‹skill/Perform› (dance) check in place of a combat maneuver check when attempting a ‹rule/reposition› combat maneuver."}

deadly_cocktail.name: Deadly Cocktail
description: ::ab{title="&L&Deadly Cocktail (Ex)&FN&" icon=power ability="A rogue with this talent can apply two doses of poison to a weapon at once. These can be separate poisons, in which case they both affect the target individually, or two doses of the same toxin, in which case the poisons' frequency is extended by 50% and the save DC increases by +2." special="This talent is an exception to the rule that injury poisons can only be delivered one dose at a time."}

defensive_roll.name: Defensive Roll
description: ::ab{title="&L&Defensive Roll (Ex)&FN&" icon=def flavor="With this advanced talent, the rogue can roll with a potentially lethal blow to take less damage from it than she otherwise would." ability="Once per day, when she would be reduced to 0 or fewer hit points by damage in combat (from a weapon or other blow, not a spell or special ability), the rogue can attempt to roll with the damage. To use this ability, the rogue must attempt a Reflex saving throw (DC = damage dealt). If the save succeeds, she takes only half damage from the blow; if it fails, she takes full damage. She must be aware of the attack and able to react to it in order to execute her defensive roll&mdash&if she is denied her Dexterity bonus to AC, she can't use this ability." special="Since this effect would not normally allow a character to make a Reflex save for half damage, the rogue's ‹ability/evasion› ability does not apply to the defensive roll."}

fast_tumble.name: Fast Tumble
description: ::ab{title="&L&Fast Tumble (Ex)&FN&" icon=boost ability="When a rogue with this talent uses ‹skill/Acrobatics› to move at full speed through a threatened square without provoking an attack of opportunity, the DC of the Acrobatics check does not increase by 10."}

grazing_shot.name: Grazing Shot
description: ::ab{title="&L&Grazing Shot (Ex)&FN&" icon=ranged prereq="‹race/Drow›" flavor="Particularly deft rogues can strike two foes with one well-placed shot." standard="A rogue with this talent can fire a ‹eq-weapon/hand crossbow› at an enemy who is granted ‹rule/cover› by another opponent. Make one ranged attack roll and compare the result to each opponent's AC. Each hit deals 1 point of damage. Any special weapon properties or ‹misc/precision damage› apply to only a single target, but any poison applied to the bolt affects all targets struck."}

hard_minded.name: Hard Minded
description: ::ab{title="&L&Hard Minded (Ex)&FN&" icon=def flavor="A rogue with this talent is hard to fool with illusions." passive="She automatically receives a save to disbelieve any illusion she can see each round at the start of her turn, even if she hasn't interacted with it. If she fails a saving throw against an illusion that is not to disbelieve, she can attempt to save again again 1 round later at the same DC. She gets only one extra chance to succeed at her saving throw."}

hunters_surprise.name: Hunter's Surprise
description: ::ab{title="&L&Hunter's Surprise (Ex)&FN&" icon=boost ability="Once per day, a rogue with this talent can designate a single enemy she is adjacent to as her prey. Until the end of her next turn, she can add her sneak attack damage to all attacks made against her prey, even if she is not flanking it or it is not flat-footed."}

improved_evasion.name: Improved Evasion
description: ::ab{title="&L&Improved Evasion (Ex)&FN&" icon=def ability="This works like ‹ability/evasion›, except that while the rogue still takes no damage on a successful Reflex saving throw against attacks, she henceforth takes only half damage on a failed save. A ‹misc/helpless› rogue does not gain the benefit of *improved evasion.*"}

knock_out_blow.name: Knock-Out Blow
description: ::ab{title="&L&Knock-Out Blow (Ex)&FN&" icon=lower ability="Once per day, the rogue can forgo her sneak attack damage to attempt to knock out an opponent. She must declare the use of *knock-out blow* before she makes the attack. If the attack hits, it does normal damage, but instead of dealing sneak attack damage (and instead of any effect that triggers when the rogue deals sneak attack damage), the target falls ‹misc/unconscious› for 1d4 rounds. A successful Fortitude save reduces this effect to ‹misc/staggered› for 1 round. The DC of this save is equal to 10 + 1/2 the rogue's level + the rogue's Intelligence modifier."}

light_walker.name: Light Walker
description: ::ab{title="&L&Light Walker (Ex)&FN&" icon=boost-power ability="The rogue can move at full speed through ‹rule/difficult terrain› and can take 5-foot steps into difficult terrain." prereq="‹talent/Ledge walker› rogue"}

opportunist.name: Opportunist
description: ::ab{title="&L&Opportunist (Ex)&FN&" icon=power ability="Once per round, the rogue can make an attack of opportunity against an opponent who has just been struck for damage in melee by another character. This attack counts as an attack of opportunity for that round." special="Even a rogue with the ‹feat/Combat Reflexes› feat can't use the *opportunist* ability more than once per round."}

quick_shot.name: Quick Shot
description: ::ab{title="&L&Quick Shot (Ex)&FN&" icon=ranged ability="Whenever the rogue rolls initiative, she can also make a single attack with a ranged weapon as a @HLswift_action. She can use this ability only if she has a weapon in hand and it is loaded (if applicable)." special="If more than one rogue has this talent, their initiative check results determine the order in which they make their attacks. After these attacks are resolved, the round proceeds as normal."}

redirect_attack.name: Redirect Attack
description: ::ab{title="&L&Redirect Attack (Ex)&FN&" icon=def ability="Once per day, when a rogue with this talent is hit with a melee attack, she can redirect the attack to strike at an adjacent creature with a @HLfree_action. The creature targeted must be within melee reach of the attack that hit the rogue, and the creature that made the attack against the rogue must make a new attack roll against the new target."}

reflexive_shadow_shield.name: Reflexive Shadow Shield
description: ::ab{title="&L&Reflexive Shadow Shield (Su)&FN&" icon=def immediate="Once per day, the rogue can gain an amount of cold ‹umr/resistance› or electricity resistance equal to half the rogue's level. This resistance lasts for 1 round." special="If the rogue has the *shadowy resistance* racial trait, the cold or electricity resistance stacks with the resistance that trait grants; otherwise, the energy resistance does not stack with any cold or electricity resistance the rogue has." prereq="‹talent/Resiliency›"}

shrinewalk.name: Shrinewalk
description: ::ab{title="&L&Shrinewalk (Sp)&FN&" icon=power-magic order=a2 ability="Council agents can walk the mystic paths between Westcrown's shrines. A rogue with *shrinewalk* can create her own shrine simply by designating an area in any urban region by placing a unique marking or rune on a wall or the ground. This marking is not magical, and if it is defaced or erased, it can no longer be used by the rogue (the marking can be hidden from view without removing its usability, including painting over the marking in question)." ability2="Once placed, the rogue can use ‹spell/word of recall› once per day to return to the shrine." special="A rogue can maintain one shrine at a time; if a new marking is created in a new location, the previous shrine becomes inactive."}

stealthy_sniper.name: Stealthy Sniper
description: ::ab{title="&L&Stealthy Sniper (Ex)&FN&" icon=boost ability="When a rogue with this talent uses the ‹skill/Stealth› skill to snipe, she only suffers a -10 penalty on the Stealth check, instead of -20."}

unwitting_ally.name: Unwitting Ally
description: ::ab{title="&L&Unwitting Ally (Ex)&FN&" icon=power ability="A rogue with this talent can spend a @HLswift_action to attempt to make an opponent act like an ally for purposes of providing a ‹rule/flank› until the beginning of the rogue's next turn. The opponent must be able to hear and see the rogue, and the rogue must succeed at a Bluff check opposed by the opponent's Sense Motive. If the check succeeds, the opponent acts as an ally for the purpose of providing a flank." special="Whether or not the check succeeds, the rogue cannot use this trick again on the same opponent for the next 24 hours. If the rogue fails the check by 5 or more, she cannot use the *unwitting ally* ability on any opponent within line of sight of the failed attempt for 24 hours."}

weapon_snatcher.name: Weapon Snatcher
description: ::ab{title="&L&Weapon Snatcher (Ex)&FN&" icon=melee ability="A rogue with this talent can make a ‹skill/Sleight of Hand› check in place of a combat maneuver check when attempting to ‹rule/disarm› an opponent."}

cutting_edge.name: Cutting Edge
description: ::ab{title="&L&Cutting Edge (Ex)&FN&" icon=power ability="A rogue with this ability immediately selects two additional skills with her *rogue's edge* ability." special="She can select this advanced talent multiple times."}

feat.name: Feat
description: ::ab{title="&L&Feat&FN&" icon=power ability="A rogue may gain any feat that she qualifies for in place of a rogue talent."}

frugal_trapsmith.name: Frugal Trapsmith
description: ::ab{title="&L&Frugal Trapsmith (Ex)&FN&" icon=boost ability="When a rogue with this talent constructs a mechanical trap, she only pays 75% of the normal cost."}

getaway_master.name: Getaway Master
description: ::ab{title="&L&Getaway Master (Ex)&FN&" icon=info ability="A rogue with this talent gains a +10 bonus on all ‹rule/driv«e»<ing> check«s›." prereq="‹talent/Getaway artist›"}

hide_in_plain_sight.name: Hide in Plain Sight
description: ::ab{title="&L&Hide in Plain Sight (Ex)&FN&" icon=power-def ability="A rogue with this talent can select a single terrain from the ranger's ‹ability/favored terrain› list. She is a master at hiding in that terrain, and while within that terrain, she can use the ‹skill/Stealth› skill to hide, even while being observed." special="A rogue may take this advanced talent more than once, each time selecting a different terrain from the favored terrain list."}

master_of_disguise.name: Master of Disguise
description: ::ab{title="&L&Master of Disguise (Ex)&FN&" icon=boost ability="Once per day, a rogue with this talent gains a +10 bonus on a single ‹skill/Disguise› check."}

master_tricks.name: Master Tricks
description: ::ab{title="&L&Master Tricks&FN&" icon=power ability="The rogue can select a ninja trick from the list of ‹ability/master tricks› in place of a rogue talent. The rogue cannot select a ninja trick that has the same name as a rogue talent. The rogue can choose but cannot use tricks that require ki points, unless she has a ki pool."}

greater_multitalented.name: Greater Multitalented
description: ::ab{title="&L&Greater Multitalented (Ex)&FN&" icon=power ability="A rogue with this talent can use the *multitalented* rogue talent to gain additional uses of *advanced talents.*" prereq="‹talent/Multitalented›"}

pierce_the_darkness.name: Pierce the Darkness
description: ::ab{title="&L&Pierce the Darkness (Ex)&FN&" icon=power flavor="The rogue can extend her senses of hearing and smell in darkness or when blinded." ability="She gains ‹umr/blindsense› out to a range of 5 feet, but only against creatures concealed by darkness or her own blindness. She still suffers the normal miss chance for attacking creatures with ‹rule/concealment›."}

rumormonger.name: Rumormonger
description: :::ab{title="&L&Rumormonger (Ex)&FN&" icon=power action=Ability}

A rogue with this talent can attempt to spread a rumor though a small town or larger settlement by making a ‹skill/Bluff› check. She can do so a number of times per week equal to her Charisma modifier (minimum 0). The DC is based on the size of the settlement, and it takes a week for the rumor to propagate through the settlement. If the check succeeds, the rumor is practically accepted as fact within the community; succeeding by 5 or more over the DC decreases the time it takes the rumor to propagate by 1d4 days. A failed check means the rumor failed to gain traction, while failing by 5 or more causes the opposite of the rumor or some other competing theory involving the rumor's subject to take hold.
| Community Size | DC |
| Small town | 18 |
| Large town | 20 |
| Small city | 25 |
| Large city | 30 |
| Metropolis | 35 |

see_in_darkness.name: See in Darkness
description: ::ab{title="&L&See in Darkness (Su)&FN&" icon=power ability="The rogue gains the ‹umr/see in darkness› ability." prereq=Darkvision}

skill_mastery.name: Skill Mastery
description: ::ab{title="&L&Skill Mastery&FN&" icon=boost flavor="The rogue becomes so confident in the use of certain skills that she can use them reliably even under adverse conditions." choice="Upon gaining this ability, the rogue selects a number of skills equal to 3 + her Intelligence modifier." ability="When making a skill check with one of these skills, she may take 10 even if stress and distractions would normally prevent her from doing so." order=ca special="A rogue may gain this special ability multiple times, selecting additional skills for skill mastery to apply to each time."}

skill_mastery_unchained_rogue.name: Skill Mastery
description: ::ab{title="&L&Skill Mastery&FN&" icon=boost flavor="The rogue becomes so confident in the use of certain skills that she can use them reliably even under adverse conditions." choice="The rogue selects a number of skills equal to her Intelligence modifier." ability="When making a skill check with one of the selected skills (or any of the skills selected through the *rogue's edge* class feature), she can take 10 even if stress and distractions would normally prevent her from doing so." order=ca special="A rogue can gain this special ability multiple times, selecting additional skills for skill mastery to apply to each time."}

stalker_talent.name: Stalker Talent
description: ::ab{title="&L&Stalker Talent&FN&" icon=power ability="The rogue can select a ‹ability/vigilante talent<s›. For the purposes of selecting and using this talent, she counts as a 10th-level ‹class/vigilante› with the *stalker* specialization, regardless of her actual rogue level. Her sneak attack counts as a *hidden strike* with reduced damage for the purpose of determining the effects of her vigilante talent, which means, among other things, that she can't apply any of the *hidden strike talents* to her sneak attacks."}

stony_skin.name: Stony Skin
description: ::ab{title="&L&Stony Skin (Ex)&FN&" icon=def ability="A rogue with this talent gains DR 2/adamantine." special="A rogue can select this talent up to three times; each additional time the rogue selects this talent, the DR granted by this talent increases by 1."}

greater_terrain_mastery.name: Greater Terrain Mastery
description: ::ab{title="&L&Greater Terrain Mastery (Ex)&FN&" icon=boost ability="A rogue with this talent can select a single ‹ability/favored terrain›. Her bonuses in that terrain increase to +4." increment="p!Her bonuses~8~5~6~2" prereq="‹talent/Terrain mastery›"}

thoughtful_reexamining.name: Thoughtful Reexamining
description: ::ab{title="&L&Thoughtful Reexamining (Ex)&FN&" icon=roll ability="Once per day, a rogue with this talent can reroll a ‹skill/Knowledge›, ‹skill/Sense Motive›, or ‹skill/Perception› skill check to try to gain new or better information from the roll. This reroll can be made any time during the same day as the original check."}

unlock_ki.name: Unlock Ki
description: ::ab{title="&L&Unlock Ki (Su)&FN&" icon=boost ability="A rogue with this advanced talent increases the number of points in the ki pool that she gains from the ‹talent/ki pool› rogue talent to be equal to 1/2 her rogue level + her highest mental ability score modifier (Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma)." order=aw swift="In addition, she can spend 2 points from her ki pool to gain the skill unlocks for one skill of her choice as appropriate for her number of ranks in that skill. This benefit lasts for 1 minute." prereq="Has a ki pool"}
